posts.title: Small-format robots
posts.description: There seems to be something about small-format robots. Maybe it’s just me, but I feel like I’m seeing them everywhere. I think it’s a combination of two factors. First, Disney really tapped into something with the BD-1 droid in the game Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order. People fell in love with this little droid. posts.title: Stay on target!
posts.description: Of course, one week after I decide to start an Open_Duck_Mini V2, OpenBDX.org comes into existence. Figures, but I decided to stay on target.
